# Steelers select Samuels in the fifth round

#  Steelers select Samuels in the fifth round  
Apr 28, 2018 at 08:10 AM  
*   *   *   * Copied!  
**Jaylen Samuels**
**Running Back**
**North Carolina State**
**6'0, 225**
**Charlotte, N.C.**
**Mallard Creek High School**
**5th Round â 165th Overall**  
**  
CAREER NOTES**
Set the North Carolina State record for receptions in a career (202) and ranked second in school history in total touchdowns (47), fourth in touchdown catches (19) and sixth in touchdown runs (28)â¦his 47 touchdowns were third-most in the Atlantic Coast Conference...was the only active player in the nation with at least 15 career rushing and 15 career receiving touchdowns, and the first to boast those numbers since at least 2004â¦caught at least one reception in 41 straight games â the fifth-best active steak in the FBS and a program record.  
**2017 SEASON**

# Steelers select Samuels in the fifth round

**2017 SEASON**
Invited to play in the 2018 Reese Senior Bowlâ¦started all 13 gamesâ¦first-team All-Atlantic Coast choice as an all-purpose playerâ¦third-team selection by the Associated Press as a tight endâ¦hauled in 76 receptions â the third-best mark in school historyâ¦tied Torry Holt's school record with 15 receptions in the season openerâ¦his 12 rushing touchdowns stand seventh in a single-season in school history.  
**2016 SEASON**
Honored with jersey No. 1...a third-team All-ACC choice by the league's coaches and an honorable mention by mediaâ¦started 10-of-13 games playedâ¦led the team with 55 catches - ninth-best mark in school historyâ¦named the MVP in the Indolence Bowl win vs. Vanderbilt, scoring three touchdownsâ¦  
**2015 SEASON**

# Steelers select Samuels in the fifth round

**2015 SEASON**
A first-team All-ACC performer and a third-team All-Americanâ¦started 10-of-13 games playedâ¦had more receptions (65) than any tight end in the nationâ¦his 65 catches were the fifth-best mark in North Carolina State historyâ¦scored 16 total touchdowns (nine rushing / 7 receiving), tying Torry Holt (1998) as the third-best mark in a single-season in school historyâ¦earned the Torry Holt Award as the team's most valuable offensive playerâ¦scored three touchdowns on four carries in the season opener.  
**2014 SEASON**
Appeared in 13 games (two starts)â¦gained 143 rushing yards on 15 carries and added six catches for 96 yards and a touchdown.  
**  
HIGH SCHOOL**

# Steelers select Samuels in the fifth round

**2014 SEASON**
Appeared in 13 games (two starts)â¦gained 143 rushing yards on 15 carries and added six catches for 96 yards and a touchdown.  
**  
HIGH SCHOOL**
Played running back and h-back at Mallard Creek (Charlotte, N.C) High Schoolâ¦helped lead the team to a 16-0 record and the NC 4AA state title, scoring five total touchdowns (three rushing and two receiving) in the title gameâ¦rushed for 1,404 yards on 109 carries and 39 touchdowns as a senior, adding 49 catches for 932 yards and 16 touchdown catches as a seniorâ¦a 2013 Associated Press all-state selection and the Charlotte Mecklenburg I-Meck Offensive Player of the Year.
